jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Solutions Marketing
jobs.excerpt:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Solutions Marketing at Deepgram, you will be our first dedicated solutions marketer. Enterprises don't buy speech models, they buy outcomes: patient intake that never misses a medication name, drive-thrus that get the order right, federal deployments that run air-gapped. You'll translate our platform into the solution narratives, first-call decks, and proof that make those outcomes obvious to buyers, and you'll build the systems that produce them repeatably, not one asset at a time.

This role sits within Product Marketing, reports to the Senior Manager of Partner, Customer, and Solutions Marketing, and works most closely with marketing and sales. You'll also partner with Applied Engineering and DevRel on demos, Demand Gen on vertical campaigns, and Partner and Customer Marketing on proof and distribution.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the solutions bill of materials end-to-end: for each priority use case and vertical, build and maintain the narrative, first-call deck, solution brief, hero demo script, battlecard, proof points, and web copy, refreshed quarterly. If sellers are not using it, it does not count.

 - Build use-case-first messaging with vertical multipliers: anchor on what buyers deploy (voice agents for support, clinical documentation, ordering, intake) and layer verticals on top (healthcare and pharma, federal and public sector, financial services, CX and restaurants)

 - Lead the solutions layer of every major launch: own the "what this unlocks for your industry" story, including named accuracy metrics that set the category's measuring stick

 - Be the voice of the market: mine sales calls, win-loss, and usage patterns for messaging evidence; sit in prospect calls; turn deployments into segment proof points with Customer Marketing

 - Feed demand gen and the field: hand campaign-ready narratives and landing-page messaging to Demand Gen, package enablement with GTM Enablement, and route solutions content through co-marketing with Partner Marketing.

 - Own competitive positioning by segment against AI-native voice platforms, hyperscaler models, and legacy vendors

 - Build the solutions content engine as a repeatable AI-powered system (intake, production, distribution, measurement) and publish the reusable pieces so PMM peers self-serve from what you build

YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have built solutions, portfolio, or vertical marketing programs before and can show us the work: solution briefs you wrote, first-call decks sellers ran with, plays that moved pipeline

 - Think of solutions marketing as a revenue function, measured in pipeline, win rates, and deal velocity

 - Go deep on technical products: you'll run our APIs, build simple demos from our docs, and hold your own with Product and Engineering

 - Work AI-first by default: you prototype with AI before you brief, and you build workflows instead of repeating tasks

 - Can write for a CTO and a CX ops leader in the same week without either noticing a template

 - Are excited about voice AI and want to define how a category gets bought

IT'S IMPORTANT TO US THAT YOU HAVE

 - 5–7 years of solutions, product, or portfolio marketing experience in B2B SaaS, with at least one technical or API-first product; this is a senior role

 - A portfolio of solutions marketing work to present during the interview: solution briefs, first-call decks, battlecards, sales plays. We will ask to see it.

 - Proven use of AI to accelerate workflows, content creation, and program scale; daily AI use is the baseline, building reusable systems with AI is the bar

 - A track record of translating a multi-product portfolio into segment narratives with measurable pipeline or win-rate impact

 - Hands-on enablement experience: content sellers actually used, with the feedback loops to prove it

 - Demand gen partnership fluency: you understand pipeline mechanics and have handed campaign-ready messaging to a demand gen team

 - Excellent writing that survives contact with technical reviewers and enterprise buyers alike

IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU HAD

 - Experience in voice AI, conversational AI, CCaaS, or speech technology

 - Background marketing into a regulated vertical (healthcare, federal, financial services)

 - Analyst relations exposure or benchmark/named-metric storytelling experience

 - Public speaking or webinar presenter experience

 - Track record in high-growth startups where you built the function's systems from scratch

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Voice agents are becoming standard infrastructure for customer-facing businesses, and the platform teams build on decides whether they ship something production-grade or something that stalls in a demo. Deepgram Voice Agent is a single, unified API that combines speech-to-text, LLM orchestration, and text-to-speech in real time: the full voice stack, owned end to end. We're looking for a Senior PMM to own our go-to-market motion and make Deepgram the default teams reach for when they move from prototype to production.

This is a market ownership role. You'll define how Deepgram shows up in a crowded, fast-moving category, build the narrative for where an owned, end-to-end runtime fits across how teams build voice agents, drive adoption from developer trial through enterprise deployment, and own product launches as they come. You'll work across Product, Sales, Developer Relations, and Demand Gen to keep the voice agent story consistent, compelling, and closing deals.

We're an AI-native team. We expect AI to be woven into how you work, not something you reach for occasionally.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the voice agent category narrative. Define what a production-grade voice agent platform is in a way that plays to Deepgram's strengths: one owned, end-to-end stack with sub-300ms latency, barge-in, and turn-taking.

 - Build and execute GTM strategy across developer adoption, pipeline influence, and account expansion. Voice agents are where STT, TTS, and LLM orchestration come together; own the full-stack story while knowing how the pieces show up in broader deals.

 - Lead product launches for Voice Agent releases: new conversational capabilities, latency and quality advances, BYO model support, deployment and compliance options. Clear messaging, sharp launch plans, tight cross-functional execution.

 - Own positioning across the build spectrum. Understand the different approaches teams take to building voice agents, from DIY frameworks to managed platforms and enterprise suites, and build the battlecards, objection-handling guides, and build-vs-buy narratives that show why the unified-API approach wins for production. Many players here are partners who embed Deepgram as their speech layer.

 - Enable sales and build proof points. Collateral, customer stories, benchmarks, and TCO narratives that win voice agent deals and stand up to technical and economic scrutiny.

 - Collaborate with Product on market and competitive intelligence: what voice agent builders need, what the market is shipping, where it's going.

 - Drive developer-facing content and awareness with Developer Relations: tutorials, documentation messaging, reference architectures, use case content, and SEO tied to how voice agent builders actually search.

 - Build AI-assisted PMM workflows. Use AI to accelerate research, competitive synthesis, and content production. Build repeatable systems, not one-off prompts. You set the strategy; AI handles the first drafts.

YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Are energized by owning a market, not just supporting a product. You want to shape how buyers think about the problem.

 - Understand the voice agent stack well enough to tell a coherent story about why an owned, end-to-end platform beats a stitched-together one, and where the build-vs-buy line falls for different buyers.

 - Move fluidly between a developer audience and a business buyer without losing either one.

 - Are comfortable marketing a product with both a technical architecture story and an experiential one, where one buyer is reading API docs and another is judging whether the agent sounds and responds like something they'd put in front of customers.

 - Default to AI-first: you use AI continuously, have good judgment about when it's wrong, and think in systems rather than one-off prompts.

IT'S IMPORTANT TO US THAT YOU HAVE

 - 5+ years of product marketing experience, including at least 2 years on infrastructure, API, or developer-facing products.

 - Strong messaging skills: you can build a positioning architecture from scratch and know the difference between a message that's technically accurate and one that actually moves people.

 - A high bar for quality: you notice when copy is off, when a layout doesn't work, when creative doesn't match the brand, and you can give useful feedback on all of it.

 - Working knowledge of the AI landscape: frontier models, major LLM providers, how the ecosystem fits together. You need to talk about this credibly with technical buyers.

 - Technical depth: you can engage with engineering and product teams, read API docs, and translate product-level details into market-facing narratives without oversimplifying.

 - Fluency in both product-led and sales-led growth motions, and how they interact.

 - Demonstrated AI fluency: concrete examples of AI-assisted workflows you've built, iterated on, and measured, with specific outcomes to back it up.

IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU HAD

 - Experience in the voice AI space and familiarity with how STT, TTS, and LLMs come together in a production voice agent stack, and with the range of ways teams build voice agents, from DIY frameworks to managed platforms.

 - Hands-on experience with AI-native tools across the stack: agentic coding (Claude Code, Codex) and collaborative work tools (Cowork, etc.).

 - Experience with technical proof points, model benchmarks, or evaluation frameworks. In voice agents, buying decisions often come down to a live conversation that either feels natural or doesn't.

 - Comfort operating where the playbook doesn't fully exist yet and you're building it as you go.

 Coordinate and execute a comprehensive marketing strategy for cybersecurity across key segments: enterprise security operations, threat intelligence, detection and response, governance/risk/compliance, MSSPs and more 
 Craft differentiated positioning and messaging across solutions pages, campaign materials and content for distinct audiences within the vertical 
 Support go-to-market for product and solution launches including sector-specific offerings and relevant MCP integrations and skills (SIEM, SOAR, EDR, threat intelligence platforms, etc.) 
 Partner with the alliances team on joint go-to-market with cybersecurity partners, including shared positioning, launch coordination, and integrated campaign moments across security platform and services partners 
 Partner with communications on executive thought leadership regarding AI's potential to tip the balance toward defenders, including flagship announcements in the context of key security initiatives 
 Work with the social and content teams on a cybersecurity content calendar that highlights use cases, case studies, and partnership announcements 
 Drive thought leadership initiatives and speaking / event opportunities relevant to the security community 
 Enable sales teams with compelling materials, outbound campaigns, and pipeline-driving initiatives for security-led enterprise accounts 
 Report on which channels and campaigns are driving results and identify opportunities for iteration

jobs.title: GTM Enablement Manager (Technical)
jobs.excerpt:
OVERVIEW

At Apollo GraphQL, we're on a mission to make it radically easier for engineering teams to ship fast, reliable products and services on top of the world's data, powering everything from web to mobile to agentic experiences.

We're looking for a GTM Enablement Manager who enjoys translating technical concepts into language the field can use with confidence — someone who's as comfortable in a room with engineers as they are building the materials an AE needs to navigate a tricky customer conversation. This is a builder role — you'll own the strategy, content, and delivery that get our field (AEs, SEs, and CSMs) equipped to sell and support Apollo's current customers and future customers.

Reporting to the Head of Sales, you'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, and Field leadership — so the work you do shows up directly in how fast the team ramps and how well we retain customers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and own our enablement strategy end-to-end, building role-based learning paths for AEs, SEs, and CSMs across self-directed learning, just-in-time delivery, micro-learning, and major learning events.

 - Partner with RevOps to define field productivity baselines and the leading indicators — ramp time, certification engagement, time-to-first-value — that connect enablement work to business outcomes, and track whether training is actually landing over time.

 - Build a new-hire onboarding program from scratch, focused on minimizing ramp time and time-to-productivity for new field ICs.

 - Lead go-to-market readiness for major product releases, working closely with Product Marketing to take their messaging and turn it into use-case narratives, competitive intelligence, and customer-facing materials the field can actually use — then own getting it into their hands and taught.

 - Act as the connective tissue between engineering and the field, translating what's shipping and why it matters into language non-technical AEs and CSMs can use with confidence in front of customers.

 - Deliver training that actually lands — not just build the content, but leading the sessions, measuring impact and effectiveness, and adjusting as needed.

 - Bring AI into how the field works, using it to speed up content creation, mine tools like Gong for field insights, and track how reps are positioning Apollo with customers — while coaching AEs and CSMs on how to use AI in their own workflows.

 - Drive alignment across teams that don't report to you, pulling input and buy-in from Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Field leadership to get assets built and adopted.

WHO YOU ARE

You sit comfortably at the intersection of technical credibility and commercial fluency — equally at home talking API architecture with an engineer and coaching an AE on how to position it to a VP of Engineering. You think of enablement as part of the go-to-market engine, not a support function on the side of it. Your goal isn't to run a training calendar — it's to make the field measurably better at their jobs.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

 - Experience operating in a fast-moving, high-growth environment, where you're helping shape the playbook rather than following one.

 - Hands-on experience building and delivering enablement programs — not just managing or orchestrating other people's content.

 - Real technical fluency: you understand the API layer and can converse credibly with engineers, with familiarity with GraphQL a plus (though not required at expert level).

 - Commercial acumen: you understand how enterprise buyers (VPs of Engineering, platform leaders, CTOs/CIOs) evaluate and buy infrastructure and developer tooling, and can convert technical capability into business value language a non-technical field IC can use with confidence. Familiarity with sales methodologies like MEDDPICC and Command of the Message, and the ability to reinforce them through enablement content.

 - A proven track record of live delivery — not just content creation. You can teach a technical concept to a non-technical audience, read whether it's landing in real time, and adjust.

 - Demonstrated ownership in ambiguous environments: you've built something from scratch before, set your own priorities, and been accountable for the result.

 - Strong cross-functional influence skills: you've driven alignment and gotten things built by pulling in people who don't report to you.

 - Practical, hands-on AI fluency, not just familiarity — you've used AI as a force multiplier to get more out of your own work, and you can teach non-technical teammates to do the same.

ABOUT APOLLO

Apollo helps teams build, operate, and scale the graphs that power modern applications. If you've streamed a show, booked a trip, or read the news online, there's a good chance Apollo was working quietly behind the scenes. We support some of the largest and most sophisticated GraphQL platforms in the world.

But we're not here just to maintain the status quo. Apollo is redefining how software teams build and ship — bringing clarity, speed, and leverage to increasingly complex systems. Our platform gives teams a single, coherent way to connect clients, services, and now AI-powered experiences, without drowning in endpoints or bespoke integrations.

Just as importantly, we're building a company where ambitious people can do the best work of their careers. That means meaningful ownership, smart teammates, and tackling hard problems that actually matter. If you like moving fast, thinking deeply, and helping shape what comes next, you'll feel right at home here.

Equal Opportunity: Apollo is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a talented and diverse workforce.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
The U.S. mortgage market is a $14 trillion pillar of the economy — and much of it still runs on fax machines, overnight shipping, and manual workflows. Snapdocs is changing that. Our platform currently powers 20% of all real estate closings in the country, and we’re just getting started.

We design workflow software and AI-driven automation that connects lenders, settlement teams, notaries, and investors — eliminating friction, reducing risk, and delivering a faster, simpler closing for every borrower. Our customers range from the largest mortgage lenders to independent title companies. They trust us because we solve real operational pain with empathy, rigor, and reliability.

We’re backed by Sequoia, Y Combinator, and F-Prime, and we’re building for the long term.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Snapdocs is the trusted infrastructure for high-stakes transactions. We started in mortgage, where trust is not assumed, the work is fragmented across many parties, and the cost of mistakes is real - and are bringing that same standard of trust to other markets.

Years of automating the hardest tasks gave us something more foundational than workflow software: an AI-native platform that makes complex work easy to complete, hard to get wrong, and built to withstand scrutiny over time.

Field marketing turns that promise into tangible presence and relationships in the market by owning the programs that put Snapdocs in front of the right audiences, in the right settings, for the right reasons. You’ll turn conferences, executive programs, customer gatherings, partner activations, and account-based programs into credible brand experiences, tight relationships, and measurable commercial impact.

THE ROLE

This is a hands-on field marketing role with broad ownership. You’ll help shape where and why Snapdocs shows up, choose the programs most relevant to our audiences and business priorities, manage the details that make those programs work, and connect every program to coordinated Sales and Marketing follow-up.

Events are the primary channel, but field marketing is broader than event execution. It also includes regional programs, executive presence, customer and prospect engagement, partner programs, and account-based plays across Snapdocs’ markets. You’ll help make our mission tangible by creating experiences that simplify complexity, build trust, and move the right relationships forward.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Take ownership of a strong, existing events lineup for mortgage, primarily geared towards sales in-person meetings, and then building the playbook for expanding event presence on-stage, in new thought-leadership forums and through field motions.

 - Strategize a new non-real-estate events plan, including identifying strategic event and field motions in priority adjacent industries, designed to establish credibility, develop relationships, and create pipeline in those markets.

 - Unify existing and new vertical field marketing strategies into a tiered event strategy across industry, partner, customer, and executive programs.

 - Decide the right level of presence for each program, from attendance and executive meetings to sponsorships, booths, speaking opportunities, roundtables, dinners, and roadshows.

 - Run event programs end to end: goals, budget, registrations, vendors, booth and materials, attendee lists, on-site execution, and follow-up.

 - Partner with Lender and Settlement Sales to connect event plans to target accounts, meetings, and next steps, ensuring event participation converts into a repeatable pipeline and revenue motion, strengthens Snapdocs’ credibility across the mortgage ecosystem and new verticals, and builds executive, partner, and customer relationships that support growth

 - Work with Revenue Marketing on pre-event outreach, in-event signal capture, and post-event follow-up, including help with prospecting, messaging and social engagement.

 - Use HubSpot as the system of record for event planning, lists, activity tracking, and handoffs, with Salesforce and Slack connected where needed.

 - Track cost per attendee, meetings booked, meeting follow-up, qualified opportunities, pipeline impact, and 30-day post-event ROI. Use what you learn to make sharper investment calls.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4+ years of field marketing, event marketing, or go-to-market marketing experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, financial services, or a similarly complex industry.

 - A track record of owning events or field programs that contributed to qualified meetings, pipeline, customer relationships, or revenue.

 - Excellent project management. You keep many workstreams moving, write clear next steps, and make it obvious who owns what and when.

 - Strong judgment on event investment. You can assess attendee lists, audience fit, sponsorship value, sales goals, cost, and expected return before recommending a program.

 - Experience working closely with sales, customers, partners, vendors, and executives. You make it easy for others to do their part and keep things from falling through the cracks.

 - Comfort learning and operating marketing automation, CRM, lead capture, or event systems. Direct HubSpot experience is a plus.

 - Experience working on a lean marketing team with broad ownership, from deciding where to invest to making sure the room is ready.

 - Ability to travel to industry events, customer programs, and executive gatherings. Travel will be dependent on the specific event needs, but this role is not required to be at every event, instead using good judgment and clear evaluation of need to determine on-site presence levels.

AI PROFICIENCY AT SNAPDOCS

AI proficiency is a core expectation at Snapdocs. We expect you to use AI as part of your day-to-day work, with real judgment about where it helps and where you need to check the output.

For this role, that might include researching events, organizing event data, drafting outreach or briefs, building repeatable planning workflows, and connecting systems for regular check-ins and next steps for supporting partners. You should be curious about new uses, able to explain what changed in your work, and willing to verify what AI produces before it reaches a customer or sales team.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

We believe in being upfront about pay. The base salary range for this role is as follows:

 - $131,000 - $150,000

Where you land within the range depends on your experience, skills, and how you'll make an impact in the role. In addition to base salary and variable compensation, this position includes meaningful equity and a comprehensive benefits package.

Why Snapdocs

We’re here to transform one of the most critical and complex industries in the world. That requires a team that is curious, driven, thoughtful, and practical. We value:

 - Deep ownership of outcomes (not just tasks)

 - Straightforward, honest communication

 - Empathy for the people who use our software

This is a place for people who want to solve hard, meaningful problems with real economic impact — not just ship features.

JOIN US

We’re expanding our product suite and the network it connects. To do that, we need people who are excited by complexity, energized by scale, and motivated to make a tangible dent in how the mortgage ecosystem works. If you’re hungry to learn, build, and lead — you’ll do the best work of your career here.

jobs.title: GTM Product Marketing Manager, Commerce Experiences
jobs.excerpt:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team 
 The GTM Product Marketing team sits within Stripe's Product Marketing org. We make sure Stripe sellers walk into every conversation prepared, confident, and armed with the right story. As Stripe's center of excellence for general product enablement, we set the standard for how sellers learn and pitch our products, drive consistency across product suites, and act as Marketing's Voice of the Field — surfacing seller insights to sharpen upstream messaging and positioning. We translate product value into seller-ready narratives, resources, and enablement — and we measure our impact on seller confidence and how effectively our teams pitch, qualify, and close. 
 Stripe's Commerce Experiences products (Optimized Checkout Suite, Link, Terminal, Agentic Commerce) help businesses convert more customers across every channel — from online checkout, to digital wallets, to in-person commerce, to the emerging world of AI-driven shopping. We're looking for an exceptional GTM product marketer to bring Stripe's story to market. In this role, you'll be the connective tissue between product, marketing, and the field. You'll translate complex commerce and checkout capabilities into compelling narratives and seller resources that resonate with our users and drive adoption. You'll equip customer-facing teams to confidently pitch all our solutions, answer technical questions, and speak to the roadmap. You'll also elevate seller and field insights to refine product positioning and messaging. 
 What you’ll do 
 As the GTM PMM for Commerce Experiences, you’ll need to quickly build a deep understanding of Stripe’s Commerce Experiences products, buyer personas, and differentiation. You will: 
 
 Own the content development and GTM enablement strategy across the sold funnel — creating seller-ready resources (pitch decks, FAQs, value props, talking points) that translate product positioning into clear, differentiated customer value propositions for enterprise, mid-market, and platform buyers. 
 Partner with Market Intelligence to monitor and understand commerce, checkout, and emerging agentic commerce market trends, competitive dynamics, and seller-facing competitive narratives — synthesize insights, and leverage these to build differentiated positioning. 
 Design and deliver training programs that build seller expertise across the Commerce Experiences portfolio. 
 Prepare sellers for major product launch events like Stripe Sessions, and to understand the details of the roadmap product is building. 
 Leverage data and insights to identify enablement and knowledge gaps, prioritize asset development, launch new content, and measure effectiveness on seller confidence and other KPIs. 
 Surface field insights on a regular cadence — through monthly readouts and structured retros — to inform core PMM positioning and product roadmap. 
 
 Minimum requirements 
 
 3+ years of product marketing experience, preferably in B2B tech. 
 Direct experience with checkout, ecommerce, digital wallets, agentic commerce or other commerce platforms is strongly preferred.  
 Experience with Enterprise sales cycles and technical products. 
 Excellent communication and presentation abilities, with a proven track record of distilling complex strategies into clear, compelling narratives. 
 Strong stakeholder management skills. 
 Ability to move quickly without compromising attention to detail or polish. 
 A self-starter who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously. 
 Comfort with data-driven decision making and measuring marketing impact. 
 Ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders across Product, Sales, and Marketing, and contribute to alignment on shared goals. 
 
 Preferred qualifications 
 
 Demonstrated comfort working with, and presenting to, senior leaders across a variety of disciplines. 
 Strong collaboration skills, a tendency to seek and share alternative views, and an ability to earn stakeholder confidence  
 Experience using or building AI-powered tooling to accelerate seller productivity or content development.

 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 
 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: 
 Interested in joining a top-notch marketing team? We are looking for an energetic, highly organized, team player who loves a fast-paced environment and thrives on results. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

The team serves as a core strategic business partner function to the GTM organization, playing a critical role in driving growth and operational excellence, and in accelerating the safe adoption of frontier AI across the world's leading enterprises. 
 We're looking for a dynamic operator: a senior individual contributor who will serve as a trusted advisor to AMER Sales Leadership, driving strategic initiatives across Anthropic's GTM organization and owning a portfolio of programs end to end. You'll build a deep understanding of our organization and priorities, where we are and where we're going, and turn that vision into plans you execute: data-driven in determining what needs to happen, creative in how you design each program, and outcomes-driven in ensuring it drives the success of the field. 
 You'll work across a wide variety of teams, including Sales, Strategy, Enablement, Marketing, and Partnerships, helping them operate as one team behind each program. 
 GTM Programs is a new function, and this is one of its first hires: an opportunity to build the function, not just join it. The timing matters: every organization is deciding its AI strategy right now, and the programs this team builds shape how our field meets that moment. You'll help define what a well-run program looks like at Anthropic, operating with high autonomy. 
 Key responsibilities

 Package what's working (industry patterns, use cases, activation motions) into repeatable plays that sellers can run without you in the room 
 Partner with Strategy, Enablement, Product Marketing, and Partnerships to build programs once and land them consistently across the field

jobs.title: Group Product Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Vanta's Product Marketing team sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success. We define positioning and narrative for Vanta's platform, translate roadmap into go-to-market motions across big launch moments and releases, and make sure the field can sell what Product is building; with research, storytelling, and cross-functional partnership as the core of how we work.

About the role

AI is one of Vanta's most strategic bets, and it needs a dedicated owner. This PMM will be focused on bringing the AI roadmap to market in close partnership with EPD. You'll own the narrative, messaging, and positioning for Vanta’s AI story end-to-end, and be the connective tissue between what Engineering and Product are building and how the market, field, and customers understand it.

You're expected to shape our AI story and define Vanta as a leader in the space, which means you’re fast-moving and nimble, have enough technical fluency to have a real point of view in roadmap conversations with EPD (including getting hands-on and testing the product yourself), paired with the storytelling and creativity to bring a unique, differentiated story to market.

What you’ll do as a Product Marketing Manager at Vanta:

 - Own the AI pillar narrative and roadmap end to end

 - Own the AI pillar narrative at key events like VantaCon, including keynote support, breakout sessions, and customer testimonials

 - Ensure a cohesive AI narrative across pillars so AI messaging holds together whether it's showing up in Compliance, Risk, or Proof contexts

 - Partner directly with EPD to understand what's being built, influence roadmap sequencing from a market/customer lens, and translate technical capability into external-ready narrative

 - Develop and maintain AI messaging and positioning that flexes across audiences (field, analysts, press, customers)

 - Drive field enablement for AI, arming Sales and CS with the story, objection handling, and proof points they need

 - Plan and execute AI product launches, from planning through post-launch measurement

 - Represent the AI narrative in customer-facing and market-facing moments (analyst briefings, customer advisory conversations, press as needed)

How to be successful in this role:

 - Core PMM experience
 
 - 7+ years in product marketing, ideally with ownership of a full pillar or product line rather than a support function
 
 - Track record of building narrative and positioning from scratch, not just executing an existing playbook
 
 - Experience partnering directly with Product/Engineering leadership
 
 - Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
 
 - Plan and execute large product launches (including partnership with comms to align on product narrative), report back on performance, and optimize our launch processes for scale
 
 - Define and manage go-to-market (GTM) strategy for Vanta’s security products, including messaging, positioning, launch planning, GTM enablement content (sales, customer success), and customer adoption
 
 - Strong written and verbal storytelling, comfortable writing for a keynote stage as well as a sales deck
 
 - Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship

 Technical / AI fluency
 
 - Working understanding of how modern AI products are built, enough to ask sharp questions in an EPD roadmap review and push back credibly
 
 - Familiarity with the current AI/LLM landscape (model capabilities, common architecture patterns, where the industry conversation is headed) so positioning reflects real technical nuance rather than surface-level buzzwords
 
 - Comfort translating technical capability and constraints into narrative that's accurate and compelling without over-claiming what the product does
 
 - Prior experience marketing an AI-native or AI-adjacent product is a strong plus
 
 - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

 Bonus points
 
 - Experience with security or technical products
 
 - Experience owning a keynote-level narrative for a company event
 
 - Background that spans both technical and brand/narrative work (e.g., came from a technical PM, solutions engineering, or technical writing background before moving into PMM)

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

 - Industry-competitive salary and equity

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

 - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

 - Health & wellness stipend

 - Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

 - Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

 - Family planning benefits

 - Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

 - Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

 - 11 company-paid holidays

 - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

 - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

You force multiply through mechanisms, building systems that reduce manual effort and driving toward automated decisioning. You translate complex marketing performance data into executive-level strategy, owning the WBR narrative for senior leadership and influencing investment priorities across the AIM organization. You shape organizational strategy and drive marketing impact at scale. Your insights don't just inform decisions, they define them. You identify gaps between teams and processes, hold partner teams accountable for improvements, and build scalable mechanisms that outlast your direct involvement. Key job responsibilities Activation Strategy & Risk Management: Own the strategic framework for weekly marketing activation logic across Americas fulfillment sites, including application need and paid application need assessments. Define the override governance model, ensuring decisions are logged and structured to accelerate automation development. Set the standard for how risk is identified, escalated, and resolved across the portfolio. Integrated Campaign Planning & Execution: Own annual integrated campaign plans for the Americas, with focus on building and testing during low-volume periods and maintaining readiness for high-volume hiring events (Peak, Prime, Hot Sale). Lead working-backwards planning from hiring projections, site capacity, and historical performance data. Consult senior leadership on quarterly strategy, budget allocation, and major campaign pivots. Translate rolling 12-week labor order visibility into dynamic marketing adjustments, flagging risks and mitigation plans early. Cross-Functional Orchestration: Drive campaign management across the Americas, leading true collaboration with Creative, Performance Marketing, Journey Orchestration, Talent Engagement, and Business stakeholders. Facilitate quarterly planning cycles, manage stakeholder expectations across business partners, country leads, and global teams, and bridge the gap between marketing capabilities and operational hiring realities. Lead integrated campaign reviews with senior leadership, presenting data-backed recommendations. Performance Optimization & Marketing Strategy: Define the strategy for channel mix, spend efficiency, fill rate improvement, and labor order projection accuracy across the Americas portfolio. Partner with analytics teams to move beyond single-metric measurement to comprehensive campaign performance frameworks. Identify systemic opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness and hold partner teams accountable for execution. Pacing & Spend Governance: Own pacing management, ensuring ramp-down and pause decisions are executed with precision and that insights are fed back into program management to improve paid marketing efficiency. Own the governance framework for spend decisions and escalation thresholds. Automation & Process Improvement: Identify, develop, and drive adoption of mechanisms that improve activation efficiency, reduce manual override volume, and accelerate the path to automated decisioning. Own the automation of campaign planning processes, from discovery through recommendation to implementation. Eliminate redundant workflows and hold partner teams accountable for process improvements across both functions. Executive Reporting & Stakeholder Influence: Own the weekly WBR deep dive for senior leadership, translating activation performance, campaign results, and fill risk into clear, strategic narratives. Maintain alignment with business managers, global risk teams, and cross-functional partners. Influence investment priorities and partner team roadmaps through data-driven business cases. A day in the life Your day begins with a review of overnight performance data, identifying anomalies, escalation triggers, and optimization opportunities. You finalize the weekly activation logic, making strategic override decisions and ensuring the log is structured to support automation development. Mid-morning, you walk down the hall to a cross-functional working session with Performance Marketing and Journey Orchestration, influencing channel investment decisions with data from the prior week's WBR. In the afternoon, you're reviewing the onboarding plan for a new internal client coming onto the activation process, ensuring intake requirements are met and the timeline is on track. You close the day finalizing the WBR narrative for senior leadership, sharpening the strategic framing and ensuring campaign performance is connected to hiring outcomes before it goes to Directors. This is an in-office role five days a week, and the pace, proximity, and real-time collaboration reflect that. About the team Workforce Staffing (WFS) hires thousands of Amazonians every year. Practicing transformational thinking empowered by leading-edge tech and tool development, this team constantly innovates new processes to increase marketing efficacy.

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience working cross-functionally and across regions - Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders - Experience creating, measuring and scaling workflow among candidates, hiring managers and the recruiting team - Experience in talent acquisition marketing, recruitment marketing, or employer brand - Experience with high-volume or seasonal marketing environments where speed and precision are non-negotiable Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role 
 The GTM Strategy & Operations, Frontier team coordinates how Anthropic's research reaches the market: how we run model launches commercially, how we partner with Capacity teams to allocate a finite compute supply across customers and surfaces, and how we translate what the field learns into reads that Research, Product, Finance, and GTM leadership act on.

 Run launches

ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Clipboard is looking for a Sales Operations Analyst to help build and run the systems behind our sales organization.

You'll work across Salesforce, data, automation, and internal tools to help our sales team operate more effectively. That might mean building an automation that eliminates a recurring workflow, investigating a messy data problem, redesigning part of our Salesforce setup, or building a new system from the ground up.

We are a small team with an unusual operating model. Much of our execution runs through AI agents that we direct and quality-check, allowing each analyst to operate with the leverage of a much larger team.

This is equal parts builder and operator. You'll own systems end to end, work through ambiguous requests from reps and leadership, and be accountable for making sure the things you build actually work.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own live systems. Take ownership of production systems such as account distribution, deal intelligence, competitor tracking, and data sync pipelines. You'll be accountable for their accuracy and reliability.

 - Solve ambiguous problems. Work through requests from sales reps, managers, and leadership, figure out what is actually needed, and execute quickly.

 - Direct AI agents. Write specs and prompts, supervise AI agents, and rigorously QA their output before it touches production data.

 - Build automations and tools. Create scripts, scheduled jobs, Slack bots, and lightweight web apps that turn recurring manual work into scalable systems.

 - Analyze and report. Use SQL and other tools to answer important revenue questions and build reporting the organization can trust.

 - Guard data quality. Handle merges, deduplication, account mapping, enrichment, and other work required to keep our systems accurate at scale.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Evidence of building. You've built scripts, automations, tools, systems, or other solutions to real problems.

 - AI-native working style. You already use AI to multiply your output and understand where it can fail and how to verify its work.

 - High judgment under ambiguity. You can take a loosely defined problem, figure out what matters, and know when to act versus when to ask.

 - Strong attention to detail. You're comfortable being the last line of defense before changes affect production systems and large datasets.

 - Bias to ownership. When something you own breaks, you don't just fix the immediate issue. You look for the underlying problem and improve the system.

SQL and Python experience are strong pluses, but we're more interested in your curiosity, judgment, and ability to ship than checking every technical box.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Salesforce administration or development experience, including flows, SOQL, or data model design.

 - Experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, analytics, or a similar environment.

 - Experience building automations with tools, scripts, APIs, or AI agents.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Application Review – We'll review your experience and evidence of things you've built, automated, or owned.

 2. Take-Home Assessment – A practical, ~2-hour assessment using a fictional company, mock website, and CRM. You'll have 48 hours to complete it, and AI tools are encouraged.

 3. Technical Walkthrough – A 45-minute session where you'll demo what you built, explain your decisions, and make a small live change to your system.

 4. Manager Interview – A 30-minute conversation focused on communication, ownership, judgment, and how you operate under ambiguity.

 5. Final Steps / Offer! – Some candidates may have an executive conversation, followed by references and an offer.

WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive base salary

 - Insurance benefits + 401k options

 - Unlimited PTO and flexible holidays

 - Remote-first working environment

To get a better understanding of the general type of people we want to hire, you can check out our blog here. https://creatingvalue.substack.com/

Quick Note on Scammers: 

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here https://forms.gle/SyGaxHFbon7Hg9fW6.

We're transforming the grocery industry 
 At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. 
 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table. 
 Instacart is a Flex First team 
 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. Why this role is on the menu 
 Media is one of Instacart's most powerful growth levers, and the team is actively evolving its operating model to serve multiple lines of business through a mix of in-house and agency-managed media. Without strong operating infrastructure, the media team risks spending its time on coordination and manual workarounds rather than strategy, innovation, and campaign performance. This role exists to design, own, and continuously improve the core mechanics of how the media team plans, executes, and optimizes work. Twelve months from now, the media team will operate with a clear, scalable, and trusted operating system that makes it easy to do great work without reliance on tribal knowledge. 
   
 What you'll cook up in your first year 
 
 Media's planning frameworks, templates, and cadences are redesigned and adopted across the team, driving clarity and accountability in annual and quarterly planning cycles. 
 A scalable media operating system is in place: budget pacing, performance reporting, campaign enablement, and process automation are governed by clear standards and a maintained roadmap. 
 Intake, automation, and workflow tooling are simplified and reliable, with manual double-entry eliminated through well-scoped AI and automation solutions. 
 Cross-functional operating rhythms, including business reviews and integrated campaign program management, run with transparent workback schedules, strong stakeholder communication, and consistent follow-through. 
 Change management for new systems and processes is executed effectively, with documentation, training, and communication plans that drive adoption across media and partner teams. 

 The secret ingredients we're looking for 
 Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications) 
 
 7 to 10 or more years of experience in Marketing or Media Operations, Program Management, Business Operations, or a closely related field within complex, cross-functional organizations. 
 Demonstrated experience as a senior individual contributor with real decision authority and ownership over cross-functional operating systems. 
 Fluency in program management: workback schedules, risk management, project velocity, and hands-on ownership of project management tooling for non-technical teams. 
 Systems mindset: proven ability to take fragmented or inconsistent processes and make them clearer, simpler, and more reliable, with a track record of building standardized templates and driving adoption across multiple teams. 
 Strong understanding of how media teams plan, intake, prioritize, and execute work at scale, including familiarity with media tech stacks. 
 Excellent written communication and structured thinking, with the ability to turn complex inputs into crisp narratives and leadership-ready materials. 
 Analytical fluency: comfortable working with performance metrics and basic financial concepts, and able to pressure-test assumptions and identify gaps. 

 Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications) 
 
 Practical experience using automation and AI tools to streamline workflows, such as meeting prep, intake triage, and template population. 
 Experience in retail, consumer tech, or marketplace businesses.

Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us! As a Field Marketing Manager you will support our Third Party & Partner Events strategy, owning the end-to-end execution, experience, and sales enablement of our third party conferences, partner co-marketing events, and sponsorships. You will own the outcomes of execution: ensuring every event we show up to, whether we're hosting a booth, sponsoring a session, or co-hosting with a partner, is delivered through clear communication and with quality, completeness, and results that align with our larger business goals and expectations. Your focus will be on the how, from documentation, contracting and shipping to on-site staffing and travel, including your own. 
 This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States. This role requires up to 50% travel, including potential international travel. 
 What you'll do at Figma: 
 
 Own end-to-end execution of third-party and partner events, sponsorships, conferences, trade shows, and co-marketed activations, from contracting and vendor management through registration, badge logistics, booth/exhibit fulfillment, shipping, inventory, and on-site staffing plans 
 Independently manage the event portfolio: scope the work, sequence tasks, estimate timelines, and adapt plans as requirements shift, incorporating AI tools to move faster without sacrificing quality 
 Coordinate all travel logistics for the events team and Figma attendees (executives, sales, speakers), including flights, lodging, ground transport, and visas for international events 
 Serve as Figma's primary on-site point of contact, troubleshooting in real time and proactively managing risks or blockers to deliver a polished, on-brand experience 
 Negotiate and manage relationships with third-party event organizers, partners, and vendors to maximize value and minimize risk 
 Measure the impact of your work: budget reconciliation, post-event ROI reporting, and proactive recommendations based on outcomes 
 Partner with Sales, Field Marketing, and Partner Marketing to identify the right events to attend or sponsor, and ensure sales enablement (calendaring, briefing docs, lead capture) is in place ahead of each one 
 Turn patterns and best practices, including AI tools, into repeatable logistics playbooks and checklists so the third-party/partner motion scales, sharing your reasoning clearly with teammates along the way 
 
 We'd love to hear from you if you have: 
 
 4+ years of experience in event logistics, event operations, or field marketing, with direct ownership of on-site execution and all logistical aspects of events big and small — vendor and venue coordination, shipping/inventory, registration, on-site staffing, and travel 
 Strong vendor and partner relationship management skills, including contract negotiation 
 A track record of owning outcomes independently, planning and sequencing complex, multi-part projects with minimal oversight 
 A calm, solutions-oriented approach to the curveballs of live events, adapting on the fly and managing risk while keeping things moving, backed by excellent written and verbal communication with internal stakeholders and external partners/vendors 
 Comfort with up to 50% travel, including some international and weekend travel 
 
 While it's not required, it's an added plus if you also have: 
 
 Experience with event management, registration, and exhibitor platforms (e.g., Cvent, RainFocus) and CRM systems (Salesforce, Sooominfo) 
 Familiarity with international event logistics, including customs/carnet processes for shipped materials

About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role 
 This is a partner marketing role that demands product marketing craft. You'll be the single-threaded owner of how every Claude launch lands on partner marketing surfaces. We reach many of our most important customers through our partners. When we ship a new model or capability, it doesn't just launch on first-party surfaces; it launches across our growing partner ecosystem, each with their own product pages, blogs, seller enablement, and go-to-market motions. Our product release cadence has accelerated, and we're looking for someone to own that translation end-to-end. 
 Model and capabilities launches are the core of the job and the majority of the work. The rest is solution launches — the joint and co-built solutions that land on partner surfaces alongside our models. The two halves reinforce each other. Model launches create the moment; solution launches translate what’s possible for the sellers and customers on the other side. 
 You'll be the first dedicated owner of launch readiness across our partner surfaces, consolidating work currently spread across several people and creating a center of excellence for how we do this work. This role centralizes launch coordination for our partners — briefing partner teams under confidentiality, shaping how our positioning shows up on their surfaces, and orchestrating execution cross functionally. You'll be the person who knows exactly what's available on which surface, how we're messaging it, and how it all fits together. You will use this knowledge to ensure our launches are positioned for the highest impact and amplification across our partners. 
 The job is roughly half launch execution and half building. On the execution side, you'll run the launch playbook. On the building side, you'll define what we haven't had the bandwidth to create yet. You'll set the standard for how Anthropic shows up on partner surfaces and hold the rest of the company to it, without anyone involved reporting to you. 
 Anthropic reaches a substantial share of its customer base through partner surfaces, and the ecosystem is still growing. How Claude shows up on the platforms where enterprises actually buy AI is largely unwritten. This is the role that writes it.

 Own partner launch readiness end-to-end, serving as the directly responsible individual for every model, feature, and solution launch across the partner ecosystem — from the first briefing through launch-day go-live and reach reporting

 Build post-launch momentum through partner webinars, technical content pipelines, and campaigns that keep partners selling after launch-day 

 Represent the partner perspective internally — surface Anthropic-direct launches that will affect partner relationships, flag partner-experience issues in product decisions, and make sure partner considerations arrive early rather than as a fire drill

 About the Role 
 This is your chance to shape the foundation of a fast-growing, high-impact part of Gusto's business as a Senior Sales Operations Analyst supporting our Expansion Sales organization. You'll build the insights and AI-powered solutions that make a large, multi-team sales organization more productive — spanning our Platform Sales, Expansion AM, and New Expansion Advisor teams. You'll sit at the intersection of data, process, and execution; you'll turn real sales challenges into the tools, reports, automations, and workflows that move the numbers. 
 You'll help grow revenue from Gusto's existing customer base through upsells and cross-sells. If you thrive where analytics, problem-solving, and supporting others meet, this role offers ownership, visibility, and the chance to influence how Gusto expands its relationship with the small businesses it already serves. 
 About the Team 
 The Expansion Sales Operations team partners closely with sales leadership to support three dynamic, fast-moving sales teams that contribute meaningfully to Gusto's growth. We think of ourselves as builders, problem solvers, and strategic partners; we turn uncertainty into clarity and fragmented processes into scalable, repeatable systems. 
 Our work spans pacing and pipeline forecasting, quotas, trigger and backlog management, process design, data integrity, account and territory administration, rules of engagement, and increasingly, AI-driven optimization. We value curiosity, open communication, and a commitment to helping our reps operate efficiently and confidently across a multi-product, multi-team motion. 
 Here's what you'll do day-to-day 
 Analytics, Reporting & Forecasting 
 
 Build, automate, and maintain reports and dashboards that track pacing, funnel metrics, trigger and backlog health, SLAs, and rep productivity; keep definitions consistent and documentation clear. 
 Own the weekly forecast, CFQ closed-won ARR pacing, and probability-weighted pipeline forecast, feeding the Weekly Business Review (WBR) and Weekly Forecast Review (WFR) cadence for sales and executive leadership. 
 Partner with Finance and Analytics to produce operational reporting and revenue insights across dials, connects, lead passes, self-generated opportunities, and book coverage. 
 Own metric definitions and data accuracy so leaders trust the numbers they act on. 
 
 Drive AI Strategy for Sales 
 
 Identify and prototype AI and automation tools, such as process automation, analytics copilots, and call coaching, that remove manual friction from the sales process. 
 Partner with Sales, BizTech, Product, and Enablement to embed AI into daily sales workflows, improving both efficiency and effectiveness. 
 Source and lead net-new AI and automation projects, connecting data insights to process improvements that lift rep productivity. 
 
 Process Design & Continuous Improvement 
 
 Examine workflows and rep performance to identify bottlenecks; recommend and implement process and automation changes that improve conversion, efficiency, and the rep experience. 
 Evaluate Rules of Engagement (ROE) requests and comp exception asks, applying clear rules and precedent to produce fair, consistent, and binding rulings. 
 Partner with Sales Enablement to document processes, build playbooks, and drive adoption of new tools and workflows. 
 
 Operational Support & Problem-Solving 
 
 Provide day-to-day support to Expansion Sales leadership and reps: ad hoc data requests, process issues, and one-off investigations. 
 Own account and territory administration as the business evolves: assignment and coverage upkeep, book reassignments for leave and departures, large-scale account rerouting, and segment reclassification, supported by lead-routing and round-robin (ChiliPiper) automation. 
 Support onboarding and offboarding for new hires and departing reps, including roster updates, router mapping, and leave-of-absence (LOA) processing. 
 Troubleshoot reporting issues, broken workflows, missing CRM data, and gaps in pipeline visibility with fast, accurate fixes — including closed-won opportunities that didn't sync and ARR discrepancies. 
 
 Cross-Functional Partnership & Communication 
 
 Work closely with Sales Leadership, RevOps, Finance, BizTech, and Product to keep everyone aligned and remove obstacles to progress. 
 Translate sales challenges into clear business requirements; partner cross-functionally to design solutions and durable improvements. 
 Keep stakeholders aligned with clear, regular updates to managers and senior leadership on timelines, risks, and outcomes. 
 Act as a trusted advisor, bringing structure, insight, and clarity to complex or ambiguous problems. 
 
 Here's what we're looking for 
 
 5+ years in Sales Ops, RevOps, or a similar analytical GTM role; ideally in a fast-paced SaaS or fintech environment. 
 Strong Salesforce proficiency; you can spot data issues, audit pipeline problems, manage account ownership and routing, and build reports and dashboards that reps and leaders actually use. 
 Analytical depth across Salesforce reports and dashboards, SQL, Tableau or Looker, and Excel/Google Sheets. 
 Hands-on experience with forecasting, pipeline management, and territory or quota planning on a recurring cadence; for example, a weekly forecast feeding monthly reviews and QBRs. 
 Comfort evaluating AI and automation tools and prototyping simple workflows to improve productivity. 
 Excellent written and verbal communication; you simplify complex information and create alignment from frontline reps to senior directors. 
 A first-principles problem solver who breaks down ambiguous issues, tests hypotheses, and builds structured solutions. 
 Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented, you manage multiple projects and recurring workflows while protecting data quality and operational reliability. 
 A strong partner to sales, with a track record supporting teams that have competing, fast-changing priorities. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 
 Experience supporting an expansion, upsell, or cross-sell motion into an existing customer base, rather than net-new acquisition.

Our Mission: 
 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential. 
 Our People: 
 People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.  As our Partner Marketing Manager you will be responsible for turning strategic partnerships into a measurable pipeline motion- building the co-marketing programs, and partner activation strategies that help communicate the power of 6Sense alongside our key partners. This is a builder's role for someone who wants to own a meaningful piece of how 6sense grows, and who understands that great partner marketing sits at the intersection of relationship depth and disciplined execution.   
 Responsibilities :   
 
 Joint Go-to-Market Programs Build and run co-marketing programs with strategic partners ,  from end to end: partner alignment, asset development, campaign execution, field activation, and measurement. Own the pipeline contribution from partner marketing activity and be accountable for reporting it clearly.   
 Joint Events and Activations Own the partner presence at key industry events (including our own,  BreakThrough ), co-hosted webinars, and joint field programs. Coordinate  logistics , messaging, and follow-up across both sides of the partnership to make sure activations generate  pipeline .   
 Partner Relationships Serve as the primary marketing counterpart to partner marketing and alliances teams at key accounts. Build the kind of working relationships where partner counterparts are actively seeking  us out. Create  opportunities  for 6sense to  co-present at joint  events, and  develop the trust that makes joint programs move faster.   
 Partner Marketing Metrics Define what success looks like for partner marketing at 6sense,  working with marketing operations to  build the reporting infrastructure to measure it, and communicate results to marketing leadership and BD stakeholders on a regul ar  cade nce .   
 Performance Measurement   
 Partner-Sourced Pipeline Volume and velocity of pipeline generated through co-marketing programs and partner activations, tracked with clear attribution.   
 Partner Marketing Engagement Depth of engagement from partner counterparts: co-investment in programs, co-branded content produced, joint events executed, and partner-sourced leads generated.   
 Enablement Adoption Usage and effectiveness of partner-facing enablement materials, measured by partner sales team feedback and co-sell conversation rates.   
 Program Execution Quality On-time, on-brief delivery of co-marketing programs - with the partner relationship strengthened as a result.   
 
 Competencies and Behaviors:   
 
 Influence Without Authority  Operates effectively in an environment where the people you most depend on (partner counterparts, internal sales, product marketing) don't report into the same leadership. Builds alignment through credibility and relationships.   
 Revenue-First Thinking  Connects every program to pipeline and revenue. Doesn't measure success by content produced or events run. Asks "what did this produce?" and builds programs that are designed to answer that question.   
 Partner-Facing Presence  Comfortable representing 6sense externally. Shows up in partner conversations with enough confidence and preparation to be a genuine asset in the room.   
 Execution Discipline  Manages the complexity of co-marketing at pace. Gets joint programs across the finish line even when approval chains are complex.   
 Cross-Functional Orchestration Works fluidly across product marketing, demand generation, content, field marketing, and BD to bring partner programs to life. 
 
 Educational and Experience Requirements: 
 
 5 or more years in B2B marketing, with at least 2 years in a field marketing role, partner marketing, alliance marketing, or ecosystem marketing role where you owned outcomes and field programs.   
 Experience working directly with external partner stakeholders. You have presented to partner leadership, negotiated co-marketing agreements, and maintained productive relationships through disagreements.   
 A clear point of view on how to measure partner marketing impact, including how to handle the attribution ambiguity that comes with the territory.   
 Familiarity with the B2B SaaS technology ecosystem: how ISV partnerships, technology integrations, and co-sell motions work in practice.
