jobs.title: B2B Marketing Specialist
jobs.excerpt:
Who we are 
 At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go-to-market acceleration has driven industry-leading growth. In fact, we’re the largest and fastest-growing automotive marketplace, and we’ve been profitable for over 15 years. 
 What we do 
 The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride! Role overview 
 We are seeing rapid innovation in our mission to partner with automotive dealers—and we're looking for a B2B Marketing Specialist to help market and grow our portfolio of products, from core offerings to innovative new launches. This is a unique opportunity to span both the Dealer Product Marketing and Performance Marketing teams, supporting initiatives that drive acquisition, product adoption, and retention. You'll partner closely with Product, Sales, and Account Management to turn strategy into action and keep customer satisfaction at the core of everything we do. 
 This job is a good fit for someone who is curious, energized by fast-moving environments, and eager to build full-stack marketing skills—from product storytelling to performance execution. You're a proactive doer who loves owning the details, thrives on collaboration, and wants to grow quickly on a low-ego, high-impact team. No automotive experience necessary. 
 What you’ll do 
 
 Go-to-market support — Support launches and adoption efforts for dealer products, features, and programs in partnership with Product, Sales, and Account Management.  
 Campaign planning — Turn business goals into targeted, multi-channel marketing campaigns that drive acquisition, engagement, adoption, and retention. 
 Customer insights — Use dealer feedback, segmentation, and performance data to help inform messaging, campaign recommendations, and execution. 
 Positioning and messaging — Support product positioning and messaging that clearly communicates value and reflects dealer needs. 
 Campaign execution — Coordinate and execute campaigns across channels to deliver a consistent customer experience and support business goals. 
 Sales enablement — Create and maintain collateral, pitch decks, and other materials that help Sales communicate product value to dealers. 
 Performance optimization — Track results through reporting, testing, and analysis, and apply learnings to improve future campaigns. 
 Cross-functional execution — Stay organized across multiple priorities, collaborate closely with partners, and help turn strategy into action. 
 
 What you’ll bring 
 
 2+ years of experience in B2B marketing, preferably in a tech, marketplace, or other fast-paced growth environment.  
 Strong understanding of core marketing principles, with the ability to develop and execute end-to-end, multi-channel campaigns that drive business performance. 
 Analytical, data-driven mindset. Experience with marketing tools such as Marketo, Salesforce, Looker/Omni, and Google Analytics is a plus.  
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling messaging, copy, and creative.  
 Organized, adaptable, and proactive, with strong project management skills, attention to detail, and a bias for action in fast-moving environments. 
 Experience and/or ability to use AI agents to optimize workflows.

 Grafana's Demand Generation team is responsible for creating and accelerating pipeline across the full customer journey — from first touch through expansion. We run a modern, AI-forward operation: lifecycle email programs driven by an AI engine, territory-level buying signals surfaced directly to sales leaders, and agentic workflows that handle work that used to take teams of specialists. 
 We're hiring a Demand Generation Program Manager — a generalist who can own programs across channels and audiences, with a first focus on our existing-customer motion: driving expansion and cross-sell demand within accounts that already use Grafana. This is one of the biggest growth opportunities in the business and one of the least-covered by traditional demand gen. 
 This is not a "run the playbook" role. We expect this person to build with AI as a default — designing agentic workflows that scale programs beyond what headcount alone could, and pushing the team forward on how demand gen should operate in 2026 and beyond. 
 You'd be joining a demand gen team that is genuinely rebuilding how the function works — where AI agents run real production programs, and where the people on the team design the machine rather than turn the crank.  What You'll Be Doing 
 
 Own customer lifecycle demand gen. Build and run programs that create demand inside our existing customer base — expansion, cross-sell, and adoption plays across email, in-app, web, and field channels, in partnership with sales and customer teams.

 Connect programs to the sales motion. Translate marketing signals into actions sellers actually take: account coverage, buying signals, campaign follow-up. Partner directly with sales leadership on what's working.

 What Makes You a Great Fit 
 
 5+ years in demand generation, growth marketing, or lifecycle marketing at a B2B software company (open source / developer-focused a plus).

 Bonus Points For 
 
 Experience with PLG or product-led motions alongside sales-led ones. 
 Familiarity with the observability / monitoring / open source ecosystem.

 You've written or shipped something public about AI in marketing operations.

 What You'll Do 
 
 Own end-to-end execution of global campaigns, ensuring scalable, repeatable program delivery across email, paid search, webinars, events, and ABM. 
 Execute the end-to-end email development pipeline (build, QA, deploy, localize) for all campaigns through the Marketing Automation Platform. 
 Build and maintain campaign infrastructure, including workflows, templates, and processes that enable scale and consistency. 
 Coordinate email localization efforts with EMEA reviewers and translation partners. 
 Drive data-driven iteration of the email program by tracking engagement, deliverability, and pipeline contribution.

 Pilot AI-aware patterns and automation (e.g., prompt-driven drafting) within the email workflow, and partner with GTM Engineering to replace manual steps (e.g., list-upload automation). Help migrate our tech stack to an ai-native, future-proofed stack.

 What You Have 
 
 BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience. 
 3+ years of marketing automation, email marketing, or marketing operations experience (Marketo marketing automation platform preferred). 
 Hands-on execution depth in a major marketing automation platform, including segmentation, smart campaigns, dynamic content, and deliverability mechanics. 
 Curiosity about automation and AI tooling, with an eagerness to upskill into Clay, n8n, and LLM-assisted workflows. 
 Experience supporting Product Marketing, Product, and event teams on tight cycles. 
 Pragmatism around localization, regional differences, and the operational reality of multi-language sends. 
 Strong analytical ability, an evidence-driven approach to measuring/improving the email channel, and a willingness to ask new questions. 
 Outstanding critical thinking and problem-solving skills, excellent cross-functional coordination, and a passion for the email channel. 
 Familiarity with GDPR and email compliance requirements preferred.

 Email send velocity and on-time delivery

jobs.title: Senior Demand Generation Manager
jobs.excerpt:
Who Are We? 
 Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster. 
 The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman. 
 P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman. The Opportunity 
 Postman is looking for a Senior Demand Generation Manager to drive pipeline growth through high-impact digital demand generation programs anchored in content-led engagement for Fern.  
 This role sits within Revenue Marketing and is focused on turning content and digital channels into a reliable, scalable pipeline engine — connecting content strategy, organic programs, and always-on digital execution to both product-led and sales-led growth motions. You'll own how Postman attracts, engages, and converts high-intent audiences through compelling content experiences across the digital landscape, ensuring every program moves deals forward. 
 We're looking for someone who thinks in terms of pipeline and revenue, not just pageviews or content output — and knows how to build content-driven digital programs that compound over time and scale with the business. 
 What You’ll Do 
 Demand Generation Strategy & Pipeline Execution 
 
 Develop and execute a content-led digital demand generation strategy aligned to pipeline creation and revenue goals across PLG and SLG motions. 
 Prioritize content investment and channel mix based on pipeline potential, audience intent, and funnel impact — not content volume or vanity metrics. 
 Ensure digital and content execution is tightly integrated with global campaign strategy, regional GTM priorities, and product launches. 
 Continuously test and evolve content formats and distribution approaches to stay ahead of audience behavior and platform dynamics. 
 
 Content Strategy & Execution 
 
 Own the strategy and execution of digital content programs designed to drive pipeline, including: 
 
 Long-form and thought leadership content targeting developer and enterprise buyer audiences 
 Campaign-specific content assets that support awareness, consideration, and deal acceleration 
 Content experiences — landing pages, hubs, and interactive assets — optimized for conversion 
 Always-on content programs aligned to product, campaign, and GTM priorities 
 
 Ensure content is built with distribution and pipeline impact in mind from the start — not as an afterthought. 
 
 Integrated Campaign Orchestration (Content + Digital + ABM) 
 
 Execute multi-channel digital programs in close coordination with field, SEO, and ABM teams, including: 
 
 Content-led nurture and re-engagement programs 
 Account-based content plays targeting priority enterprise accounts 
 Digital amplification of content assets, events, and product moments 
 Paid media support where it accelerates content reach and pipeline impact 
 
 Ensure content programs support the full funnel — from first discovery to deal acceleration. 
 
 Sales Partnership & Account-Based Content 
 
 Work closely with sales leaders and SDR teams to: 
 
 Identify content gaps that are slowing deal progression and build assets to close them 
 Build account-specific content engagement programs that support pipeline creation and acceleration 
 Surface content engagement signals to sales for timely, relevant outreach 
 
 Act as a strategic partner to sales — ensuring content programs are aligned to territory plans and active opportunities, not just awareness goals. 
 
 Lifecycle & Conversion Optimization 
 
 Own the digital content journey from acquisition through to pipeline conversion: 
 
 Optimize content experiences, landing pages, and digital flows for engagement and conversion 
 Build and refine content-led nurture programs that move prospects through the funnel 
 Partner with product and growth teams to connect content engagement to PLG activation 
 
 Identify and close drop-off points across the digital funnel with a test-and-learn mindset. 
 
 Performance & Pipeline Accountability 
 
 Own KPIs tied to pipeline creation, content-influenced revenue, and program efficiency — not just content output or page traffic. 
 Track and report on the full content funnel: discovery → engagement → conversion → pipeline and revenue impact. 
 Partner with Marketing Analytics to build accurate attribution models and make data-driven content investment decisions. 
 Maintain clear visibility into how digital content programs contribute to Postman's global revenue goals. 
 
 What Success Looks Like 
 
 Consistent growth in content-sourced and content-influenced pipeline across PLG and SLG motions. 
 A high-performing content program with clear pipeline contribution and improving conversion rates across the funnel. 
 Tight integration between content execution and sales priorities, with strong account-based content plays in market. 
 Scalable, repeatable content-led demand generation programs that improve over time. 
 Clear contribution of digital content marketing to global revenue goals, with full-funnel visibility and attribution. 
 
 About You 
 Experience 
 
 7+ years in digital marketing, content marketing, or demand generation in B2B SaaS. 
 Proven track record of driving pipeline and revenue through content-led digital programs — not just traffic or engagement metrics. 
 Experience operating across both PLG and SLG go-to-market models. 
 Strong background in content strategy, campaign execution, and marketing automation platforms. 
 Track record of building and optimizing integrated content programs in close partnership with sales. 
 
 Skills & Approach 
 
 Thinks in terms of pipeline, accounts, and revenue  
 Strong understanding of how content drives full-funnel engagement and contributes to pipeline at every stage. 
 Comfortable operating across strategy and hands-on execution — can set the vision and run the programs. 
 Data-driven, with a sharp instinct for what content to build, where to distribute it, and how to optimize for results. 
 Able to manage complexity, prioritize ruthlessly, and execute with speed and focus. 
 
 The reasonably estimated base salary for this role ranges from $150,000 to $180,000 plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. What Else? 
 In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.  
 At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers.

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. The Community you will join: 
 Every day, Airbnb hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. Since our founding, more than 5 million hosts have welcomed over 1.5 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. 
 The Supply organization plays a pivotal role in driving the company’s growth and expansion efforts worldwide. This team recruits and develops Airbnb’s global supply of high-quality Homes, Hotels, Services and Experiences. With this focus on quality supply and international expansion, the team is leading the way for Airbnb’s continued growth and facilitation of millions more host and guest connections.  
 The difference you will make: 
 Airbnb is seeking a Platform Manager to build and improve the internal tools and workflows that power Airbnb's Supply operations teams. These are the teams that vet, onboard, and support hosts at scale and the systems that support them are fragmented, manual, and difficult to measure. This role owns the tooling and workflow infrastructure that changes that: assessing current state, designing scalable replacements, and driving delivery through to adoption.

 Define the multi-year strategy for Airbnb's ops platform -  bring a specific, opinionated proposal for what operational support looks like in 12+ months as AI takes on more of the execution, and maintain a prioritized roadmap balancing quick wins against foundational investments 
 Align vision, OKRs, strategy, and roadmap with senior leaders across Supply, Engineering, and Operations; present progress to leadership on an ongoing basis 
 Design AI-forward operational processes and determine necessity of  human-in-the-loop across or within  workflows including augmented decision making judgement 
 Decompose multidimensional product-to-ops problems define the operational requirements, and drive a coherent solution across many owning teams 
 Own case management and workforce management tooling: capacity planning, workload distribution, performance measurement, and forecasting that give operations leadership visibility and control — including forecasting for a workforce where AI agents and humans share the queue

jobs.title: Subject Matter Expert, GTM GRC - Revenue
jobs.excerpt:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Compliance and trust are the products we sell — which means the people who understand GRC most deeply sit at the center of how we win. The GTM GRC SME team brings Governance, Risk, and Compliance expertise directly into customer conversations where it materially improves qualification, solution confidence, stakeholder alignment, and post-sale success.

This is not a back-office compliance role and it is not a generic sales-engineering role. You will operate as a named member of deal teams under our pod model: paired with Strategic and Enterprise Account Executives, embedded in their weekly cadences, engaged from first discovery through POC, onsite, close, and expansion. You will be the practitioner in the room that a buyer's CISO or GRC lead trusts — and the internal expert our AEs, SEs, and marketing team build around.

What you’ll do as a Subject Matter Expert, GTM at Vanta:

 - Serve as the dedicated GRC SME for a book of Strategic/Enterprise Account Executives: join discovery and qualification calls at the earliest deal stages, scope compliance programs against Vanta's platform, and support demos, POCs, workshops, and customer onsites across Compliance, Third-Party Risk Management, Risk Management, and Trust/Questionnaire Automation.

 - Advise prospects on program architecture: multi-framework strategy, shared controls, business-unit and workspace scoping, custom frameworks, and audit sequencing.

 - Answer field questions through our SME channels at customer-forwardable quality — including reviewing and validating AI-agent-generated answers before they reach customers. Our team runs AI-first: you'll use agents daily, act as the quality gate on their output, and (ideally) build tooling of your own.

 - Design and deliver enablement: live sessions for GTM teams, bootcamp scenarios and mock-customer roleplay, async curriculum modules, and review of GRC marketing and SEO content.

 - Own monthly alignment cadences with sales front-line managers; feed structured product feedback to our Product and PM partners; carry deal context cleanly into post-sales handoffs.

 - Travel roughly once per quarter (a few days to a week) for customer onsites, POC workshops, team offsites, and events.

Domain coverage. We hire T-shaped practitioners: deep in two to three of the following pillars, conversant and demo-capable across all nine — Governance · Data Governance · Compliance · Risk Management (IT, Security, and Enterprise) · Third-Party Risk Management · Continuous Monitoring · Privacy · Trust · AI Security & Governance.

How to be successful in this role:

 - 5+ years of hands-on GRC experience, with buyer-side depth: you've built, run, or transformed a multi-framework compliance program (SOC 2, ISO 27001/27017/27018/27701, HIPAA/HITRUST, PCI DSS 4.0, GDPR and the US privacy patchwork, NIST CSF 2.0), or advised many organizations doing so.

 - Working fluency in at least one emerging area — AI governance (ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF), GRC engineering / continuous monitoring, or enterprise risk — and genuine curiosity about the rest.

 - Evidence of customer-facing range: you're credible with a skeptical CISO, a first-time founder, and a procurement team in the same week, and you enjoy the thrill of winning deals.

 - Production-quality writing: answers, scoping docs, and playbooks that can go to a customer on first draft.

 - Demonstrated AI fluency: you use LLM tooling in your compliance work today, can judge AI output against authoritative sources, and want to build with it.

 - Teaching ability: you've trained, presented, published, or enabled others, and you're comfortable building and delivering a session to a large GTM audience.

 - Sales-process literacy (MEDDPICC or similar), audit-process depth from either side of the table, and the judgment to hold scope boundaries gracefully under deal pressure.

 - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

 - Certifications (CISSP, CISA/CISM, ISO 27001 LA/LI, CIPP/CIPT, AI-governance credentials) are welcome signals, not gates.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

 - Industry-competitive salary and equity

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

 - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

 - Health & wellness stipend

 - Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

 - Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

 - Family planning benefits

 - Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

 - Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

 - 11 company-paid holidays

 - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

 - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials. 

#LI-remote

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

About Vercel: 
 Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next. 
 For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. 
 Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents. 
 We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like  OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide . Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next. About the Role: 
 Search is changing. Developers no longer just type queries into Google — they ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude, and, increasingly, they don't ask at all: their coding agents do. When a developer prompts Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or v0 to build something, the framework, deployment target, and docs those agents reach for are decided before a human ever visits a website. This is existential for Vercel: we're the agentic infrastructure platform for the agent era, agents already trigger more than half of our deployments, and being the answer that both AI assistants *and* coding agents surface, cite, and build with is quickly becoming as important as ranking on page one. 
 We're hiring a Senior Growth Marketing Manager to own Discoverability end to end: how easily developers, teams, AI assistants, and coding agents find, understand, and choose Vercel across every surface where discovery happens. You'll own our organic footprint across traditional search (SEO) and answer engines (AEO/GEO) — where "answer engines" spans both conversational assistants and the coding agents developers build with — from the technical foundation that makes our content machine-readable to the content and structure that makes us the answer. This is a senior individual-contributor role. You'll set the discoverability strategy and execute it hands-on, partnering closely with Growth Product, Content, Web Engineering, and Developer Relations. You'll report to the Head of Growth and be a key driver of Vercel's product-led, self-serve growth engine. 
   
 What You Will Do: 
 
 Own Vercel's organic acquisition strategy across SEO and AEO/GEO, with clear goals for traffic, non-branded visibility, share of voice in AI answers, how often coding agents choose and recommend Vercel, and downstream signups.  
 Lead technical SEO: crawlability, indexation, site architecture, structured data (schema), Core Web Vitals, rendering strategy, and internal linking — working directly in our stack and with Web Engineering to ship fixes. 
 Build our answer-engine strategy across both surfaces: (1) conversational assistants like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Google's AI surfaces, and (2) coding agents like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and v0. 
 Understand how each retrieves and cites content — including docs, llms.txt, structured data, and machine-readable references — and shape our surfaces so Vercel is the source they reference and the default they build with. 
 Partner with Content and PMM to build a scalable content and information architecture — programmatic pages, docs, comparison and solution pages, and editorial — that ranks and gets cited. 
 Define and own the measurement layer: instrument the funnel from organic and AI-referred discovery through to activation, choosing the tooling and building the dashboards that make discoverability performance legible to the wider company. 
 Run a continuous experimentation program (page structure, metadata, schema, content formats) and turn results into repeatable playbooks. 
 Own domain and technical health across our web properties in collaboration with Engineering — migrations, redirects, canonicalization, and international/localization structure. 
 Stay ahead of a fast-moving landscape and translate algorithm and AI-engine changes into a clear point of view and a prioritized roadmap. 
 
 About You: 
 
 6+ years in SEO, organic growth, or technical/growth marketing, with a track record of driving organic acquisition at scale — ideally for a product-led or self-serve business. 
 Genuinely technical: comfortable with structured data and schema, rendering and indexation, log-file and crawl analysis, and reading enough code to work directly in a CMS or codebase and spec fixes with engineers. 
 Familiarity with Next.js or modern frontend rendering is a strong plus. 
 Equally strong on the content and strategy side: you know how information architecture, page structure, and editorial quality drive both rankings and citations, and you can partner with writers and PMMs to make it happen. 
 Early, hands-on perspective on AEO/GEO across both conversational assistants and coding agents — you've experimented with how they retrieve, cite, and act on content (docs, llms.txt, structured references) and have opinions grounded in real tests, not just theory. 
 Fluent in the analytics stack (e.g., GSC, GA4, Ahrefs/Semrush, BigQuery or similar) and able to define your own metrics, build dashboards, and defend priorities with data. 
 A self-starter who thrives with ambiguity and ownership, and can move between strategy and execution without waiting for direction 
 
 Bonus If You: 
 
 Experience marketing to developers or technical audiences is a strong plus. 
 
 Benefits: 
 
 Competitive compensation package, including equity. 
 Inclusive Healthcare Package. 
 Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. 
 Flexible Time Off. 
 We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed. 
 
 The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $150,000 - $207,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.  
 Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.excerpt:
ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re rapidly building our marketing team to support more nurses, workplaces, and patients than ever before.

We’re looking for an energetic generalist excited to dig into all things marketing. You’ll work directly with our Head of Marketing on everything from iterating on landing pages, to designing trade show booths and collateral, to writing the messaging that millions of nurses see.

If you’re early in your career and want to get deep marketing experience at a fast growing, well funded start-up, this role is for you.

SOME THINGS YOU'LL OWN

 1. Landing Page Optimization: As we run more and more ads for our various lines of business, we need to ensure the landing pages we direct people to actually convert. You’ll own designing these pages, implementing them, and AB testing them, closely monitoring the results and iterating on what you learn.

 2. Workplace Messaging: Each day we ship new features that support workplaces. You’ll support our sales team in communicating critical messaging to our customers. This could mean building out pages on our website, creating email awareness campaigns, or assets like one-pagers our teams can distribute.

 3. Implementing Campaigns: We routinely run targeted campaigns to recruit both new workers and workplaces. You’ll own the execution, be it designing billboards, creating care-packages for workplaces, or shipping mailers.

In addition, you’ll be a crucial part of the marketing team, pushing the team’s thinking and supporting on ad-hoc projects that drive the company forward.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have 0-2 years of marketing experience. We’re not looking for an expert, but rather someone starting in their career who’s excited to dive into all aspects of the world of marketing.

You learn fast. You’ll quickly go deep on topics like web-design, paid-media strategy, and AI coding tools. None of this should feel intimidating. It should feel fun.

You’re humble. You know what you know, and more importantly, what you don’t. When you don’t know something, you’re honest about it and sprint to learn it.

You understand audience psychology and storytelling. You think about who's on the other end of what you create, what they care about, what they're skeptical of, and what will make them feel seen.

You have exceptional judgement. You understand what looks good and sounds good, what doesn’t, and why. You can create assets that resonate with your audience.

You use AI tools well. Not as a replacement for your thinking, but as an accelerant. You know what they're good at, where they fall down, and how to keep your work from sounding like everyone else's AI slop.

NICE-TO-HAVES

 - You've created social media content that drove real results (YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn)

 - You’re experienced in Figma and other design tools

 - You’ve designed things for real people, had them not work, and had to iterate on your learnings

THE DETAILS

 - Location: Remote, US-based

 - Process: Resume/Work Review → Interview with Sr. Growth Manager → Case study → Interview with Head of Marketing → Culture & Values Interview

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here https://forms.gle/SyGaxHFbon7Hg9fW6.

 You'll work closely with Marketing Operations and Performance Marketing to define how email fits into the broader GTM stack, and you'll be a key stakeholder in how we operationalize HubSpot as our lifecycle layer. Responsibilities  
 
 Own the lifecycle marketing program from lead capture through demo booked nurture sequencing, segmentation logic, and revenue tracking

 What We're Looking For 
 
 4+ years in lifecycle, email, or demand gen marketing with clear ownership of a B2B nurture program from strategy through execution 
 Hands-on experience building in HubSpot (or a comparable MAP- Marketo) — segmentation, workflows, sequences, reporting 
 Strong understanding of the handraiser-to-pipeline funnel in a B2B SaaS context, with a track record of improving conversion rates

 Experience building lifecycle programs at a product-led growth company

 Experience working alongside or standing up a Marketing Ops function from early stages

 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole.  Anthropic is seeking a candidate to drive our startup partnerships through Amazon/AWS. You'll own this key relationship, generate revenue opportunities, and work with senior leadership across both organizations to accelerate Anthropic's AI adoption for startups through AWS's global ecosystem. 
 In this role, you'll help shape how frontier AI technology is commercialized at scale and develop the blueprint for successful AI-cloud provider partnerships. 
 Key responsibilities 
 
 Develop and execute a GTM strategy for Anthropic's startup ecosystem initiatives through the Amazon/AWS partnership, including co-selling motions, enablement programs, and joint business plans 
 Build and own forecasting, pipeline development, and revenue targets for the partnership 
 Cultivate and maintain executive-level relationships across the AWS organization

 Preferred qualifications

 Prior experience working directly with Amazon/AWS partnership programs

 Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.  
 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $265,000 — $365,000 USD Logistics 
 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience 
 Required field of study:  A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. The Team + The Role 
 Pendo's Field Marketing team partners closely with Sales to create programs that drive pipeline growth, accelerate deals, and deepen customer relationships. The team builds targeted regional experiences and campaigns that bring Pendo's brand to life for enterprise prospects and customers. 
 The Field Marketing Manager is an embedded strategic revenue partner to the Enterprise sales team. You will own account-specific programs, translate intent data into targeted campaign strategies, create high-touch executive-level experiences, and co-develop territory plans with RVPs. Events are one tactic in your toolkit, not the job itself. 
 This is a hybrid role based out of our office in San Francisco, California.  
 What this looks like day-to-day 
 
 Sales alignment and territory strategy: Partner closely with RVPs and Account Directors to shape territory and account strategy from the ground up. Attend weekly team calls and account pod meetings, brief the team on campaigns and upcoming programs, and serve as the primary marketing point of contact for Enterprise sales activity in your territory. 
 Account-based and product-based programs: Own dedicated programs for your top 10 priority accounts each quarter, including executive gifting, on-site visits, bespoke events, account-specific content and ads, and direct mail. Maintain account briefs with each account pod and partner with Enterprise demand generation on a coordinated coverage model. 
 Regional field events: Plan and execute approximately three regional in-person field events per quarter in partnership with the AVP. Own pre-event and post-event strategy, attendee targeting, invite flows, day-of experience, reporting, and spend efficiency analysis so the team understands what works in your territory. 
 Intent data and signal activation: Develop working fluency in intent platforms and reports to monitor account buying signals. Review bi-weekly signal briefs and translate them into account-specific program actions, showing up to team and account pod calls with actionable account intelligence. 
 Demand generation coordination: Partner with the Enterprise demand generation team to align scaled campaigns with narrowed account and product-specific field plans. Help create a coverage model where demand generation drives broad engagement and field marketing converts account signals into targeted action. 
 Performance analysis and feedback: Analyze event and program performance metrics to understand what is working, where improvements are needed, and how future initiatives should change. Act as the feedback loop between the field and marketing by surfacing collateral, messaging, and campaign insights that can be productized for broader use. 
 
 Who You Are 
 Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work. 
 You're a builder, not a maintainer. 
 You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Field Marketing Managers don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work. 
 You're AI-curious - genuinely. 
 You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut. 
 Must-haves 
 
 Bachelor's degree and at least 3 years of relevant experience, including event planning and sales partnership in a B2B environment. 
 Demonstrated ability to partner with Sales, Demand Generation, and executive stakeholders to build programs that support pipeline growth, deal acceleration, and account engagement. 
 Strong project management and communication skills, with the ability to manage event logistics, stakeholders, timelines, invite flows, and reporting simultaneously. 
 Comfort operating in a fast-changing environment with a quick-start mentality, high production output, and the ability to work autonomously and as part of a team. 
 Agentic mindset with experience creating AI-enabled or agentic workflows to move work forward more efficiently. 
 Willingness and ability to travel for events and on-site execution. 
 
 Nice-to-haves 
 
 Background in B2B SaaS event marketing or experience embedded within a sales organization. 
 Experience using intent data platforms to inform account strategy and translate buying signals into program action. 
 Ability to leverage corporate campaigns alongside field initiatives to drive full-funnel demand. 
 Comfort building and interpreting enriched account lists for targeted account programs. 
 Product fluency and the ability to hold credible VP-level conversations about core platform use cases. 
 Proficiency with Google Suite, Salesforce, Outreach, Clay, and Splash. 
 Creative and strategic thinker with strong attention to detail and a positive, forward-thinking approach. 
 
 About Pendo 
 Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. Our mission is to improve society's experience with software. Come join one of the fastest-growing startups, supported by best-in-class institutions like Battery Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Spark Capital and Meritech.

As a Go-to-Market Specialist (GTMS) based in the US, you sit close to AWS service teams and global stakeholders, and you use that proximity to carry the reality of the China Mainland & Hong Kong market into the rooms where product and service decisions are made. You are equal parts specialist and advocate: you understand the technology deeply, you translate CMHK customer needs into a compelling case, and you influence and convince the key people who can act on it. This role is built for someone who is genuinely self-driven and accountable for outcomes. Success is not measured by activity — it is measured by results: the roadmap asks you land, the stakeholders you move, the pipeline you create, and the adoption you drive. You will operate at high intensity, hold multiple engagements at once, and keep pace with a fast-moving cloud market. You are comfortable under pressure, you take ownership without waiting to be told, and you have the personal presence and communication skills to earn trust quickly with both service-team leaders and customers. Above all, you are someone who pushes: you do not simply flag a problem, you drive the specific action that resolves it. The ideal candidate combines credible technical understanding of cloud, infrastructure, and managed services with strong business instincts and communication. You should be able to hold your own with a service-team engineer on the technical substance and, in the same afternoon, frame a crisp, data-backed argument that convinces a product leader to prioritize a CMHK customer requirement. A strong sense of ownership, a bias for action, and the ability to deliver results in ambiguity are essential. What Makes This Role Different Beyond the standard specialist mandate, we are hiring against four differentiating capabilities. Candidates will be assessed explicitly against each. 1. Real technical understanding of cloud, infrastructure, and managed services You bring a strong understanding of the cloud business — not just what a service does, but how cloud infrastructure and managed services fit together commercially and technically, where the boundaries and trade-offs are, and when a given approach is the right one for a customer. Ideally you also have a working understanding of accelerated computing and GPU-carried workloads (training or inference) and the infrastructure choices they drive. You hold a defensible technical opinion in front of both a customer architect and an AWS service team. 2. Presence, affinity, and communication that earns trust fast You build rapport quickly and are easy to work with under pressure. Your written and verbal communication is clear, concise, and persuasive, whether you are in front of a service GM, a product leader, or a customer executive. People trust you with their decisions because you are credible and you follow through. 3. Self-driven ownership and accountability for results You do not wait to be assigned work — you see what needs to happen and you own it. You set your own agenda against the outcomes that matter, you operate independently at high intensity, and you hold yourself accountable for the result, not just the effort. When something is ambiguous, you make a call and move. 4. The ability to influence and push things to happen This is the core operating trait of the role. You diagnose why a customer need is not landing with a service team, you build the case, and then you drive the relevant people — internal and external — to act on it. You escalate when you should, you disagree and commit when you must, and you do not let important things quietly stall. Prove a repeatable motion on a real win, codify it, and scale it across the field. Leverage Salesforce and internal systems to track pipeline and build the investment case.

jobs.title: Campaign Manager, Amazon Music Experiences
jobs.excerpt: Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale. The Amazon Music Experiences team is seeking a Campaigns Manager to own the full lifecycle of experiential campaigns sold to brand partners. This role sits at the intersection of sales enablement, brand partnerships, and campaign execution, owning both the pre-sale and post-sale experience for brands investing in Amazon Music's experiential portfolio. You will work directly with brands and agencies to sell, scope, and deliver world-class experiential activations that connect fans to music and culture in meaningful ways. As a Campaigns Manager, you will be responsible for building and managing relationships with brand partners and their agency teams, developing compelling experiential proposals, and ensuring flawless execution from signed IO to post-campaign wrap. You will serve as the primary point of contact for brand and agency stakeholders throughout the campaign lifecycle, translating client objectives into activations that deliver measurable results. This role requires someone who thrives in ambiguity, can manage competing priorities across multiple live campaigns, and brings a customer-obsessed mindset to every interaction. You will travel approximately 40% of the time to be on-site at activations, client meetings, and industry events. Key job responsibilities Role Summary **Pre-Sale** - Develop and present experiential campaign proposals to brands and agencies, articulating the value of Amazon Music's experiential platform and partnership opportunities. - Build and maintain a pipeline of brand prospects, proactively identifying alignment between brand objectives and Amazon Music's experiential offerings. - Partner with internal sales teams to craft custom packages that meet brand KPIs while protecting the integrity of the fan experience. - Lead pitch meetings and RFP responses, tailoring narratives to brand and agency audiences. - Develop case studies and sell sheets that demonstrate ROI and creative impact of past activations. - Drive toward and exceed a personal sales goal of $2M+ annually through new business development and renewals. **Post-Sale** - Own end-to-end campaign management from contract execution through wrap report delivery, bringing each experience to life with precision and creative excellence. - Serve as the day-to-day brand and agency contact, managing expectations, timelines, and deliverables. - Coordinate cross-functionally with production, creative, legal, finance, artist teams, and marketing to deliver on campaign commitments. - Manage campaign budgets, ensuring accurate forecasting and reconciliation. - Develop and deliver post-campaign reporting that quantifies brand value, audience engagement, and earned media impact. - Identify upsell and renewal opportunities based on campaign performance and evolving brand needs. **Building Experiences and Fan Integration** - Collaborate with artist teams to ensure brand activations complement and enhance the artist vision, creating authentic moments that resonate with fans. - Design fan-first experiences that integrate brand messaging organically into the event environment, prioritizing fan engagement over passive exposure. - Work with internal stakeholders across Amazon Music programming, marketing, and product to align experiential activations with broader strategic priorities. - Champion the fan perspective in all campaign decisions, ensuring every touchpoint delivers value to the audience while meeting brand objectives. **Agency and Brand Relationship Management** - Build trusted advisor relationships with agency planners, buyers, and brand marketing leads, driven by a customer-obsessed approach to partnership. - Educate agency and brand partners on Amazon Music's experiential capabilities, audience insights, and emerging formats. - Navigate complex multi-stakeholder environments across holding companies, independent agencies, and direct-to-brand relationships. - Represent Amazon Music Experiences at industry events, client summits, and agency days. **Internal Stakeholder Management** - Manage cross-functional relationships with production, creative, legal, finance, artist relations, and programming teams to ensure seamless campaign delivery. - Proactively communicate campaign status, risks, and opportunities to leadership and partner teams. - Operate as the connective tissue between external client needs and internal operational capabilities, translating between both audiences fluently. About the team The Amazon Music Experiences team is a pioneering business unit within Amazon Music that operates at the intersection of music, culture, brand partnerships, and live fan engagement. We are an industry-first experiences marketplace, creating a new revenue category by connecting premium brands with fans through immersive, culturally resonant activations tied to Amazon Music's artist programming and tentpole moments. Our team builds, sells, and executes experiential campaigns that go beyond traditional advertising. We design physical and hybrid activations where brands show up authentically alongside artists and fans, creating moments that drive emotional connection, cultural relevance, and measurable business outcomes for our partners. What We Do We own the full lifecycle of experiential brand partnerships, from concept creation through sales through on-the-ground execution and post-campaign measurement. Our work spans: - **Artist-Led Activations**: Partnering with artist teams to build branded experiences that complement and amplify the artist's creative vision while delivering value for brand partners. Our portfolio includes landmark executions such as Kendrick Lamar's Pop Out Experience, Bad Bunny's Residency Experience, De La Soul's DAISY Experience, and the Amazon Music 50 and Forever campaign celebrating 50 years of HipHop. - **Live Programming Integration**: Creating brand experiences within Amazon Music Live programming, including the Thursday Night Football television series, where brands engage fans in real-time cultural moments. - **Fan-First Experience Design**: Every activation we build starts with the fan. We design experiences where brand presence enhances the moment rather than interrupting it, ensuring fans walk away with a memory, not a media impression. - **Experiences Marketplace**: We have architected a scalable business model that packages Amazon Music's cultural access, artist relationships, and fan touchpoints into a marketplace where brands can invest in experiences across a range of formats, budgets, and objectives. How We Work We operate as a cross-functional team embedded within Amazon Music's Global Creative Organization (GCO), partnering closely with artist relations, programming, marketing, production, legal, and finance. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys combining strategy, execution and analysis while helping shape growing email programs with meaningful business impact.

jobs.excerpt:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role 
 Anthropic is seeking a candidate to drive our startup partnerships through Amazon/AWS. You'll own this key relationship, generate revenue opportunities, and work with senior leadership across both organizations to accelerate Anthropic's AI adoption for startups through AWS's global ecosystem. 
 In this role, you'll help shape how frontier AI technology is commercialized at scale and develop the blueprint for successful AI-cloud provider partnerships. 
 Key responsibilities 
 
 Develop and execute a GTM strategy for Anthropic's startup ecosystem initiatives through the Amazon/AWS partnership, including co-selling motions, enablement programs, and joint business plans 
 Build and own forecasting, pipeline development, and revenue targets for the partnership 
 Cultivate and maintain executive-level relationships across the AWS organization 
 Drive strategic planning and execution of joint marketing and sales initiatives 
 Design and implement scalable processes for partnership operations, including escalation management and performance reporting 
 Provide market intelligence and competitive insights to inform product and business strategy 
 Develop and execute segment-specific sales plays and enablement programs for startup audiences 
 Participate in annual business reviews with key stakeholders across both organizations 
 Identify and develop opportunities to expand the scope and impact of the partnership over time 
 
 Minimum qualifications 
 
 Experience in enterprise sales, business development, or strategic partnerships, with a focus on the startup ecosystem 
 Demonstrated ability to build and execute co-selling or joint GTM strategies with a major cloud or technology partner 
 Track record of building and maintaining executive-level relationships and influencing senior stakeholders 
 Strong command of strategic planning, business operations, and program management 
 Ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear business value for a range of audiences 
 Comfort balancing long-term strategic thinking with near-term tactical execution 
 25% travel is required 
 
 Preferred qualifications 
 
 8+ years of enterprise sales or business development experience 
 Prior experience working directly with Amazon/AWS partnership programs 
 Background in AI/ML technologies or enterprise software 
 Experience scaling partnerships in emerging or fast-moving technology markets 
 Track record of building enterprise GTM strategies in a zero-to-one or foundational capacity 
 
 Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.  
 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $265,000 — $365,000 USD Logistics 
 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience 
 Required field of study:  A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience 
 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position 
 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. 
 Visa sponsorship:  We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. 
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit  anthropic.com/careers  directly for confirmed position openings. 
 How we're different 
 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. 
 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. 
 Come work with us! 
 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:  Learn about  our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.excerpt:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role 
 Anthropic's model releases help us advance the frontier of both model intelligence and model safety. Each one brings research, product, policy, legal, communications, sales, and every part of marketing together around a single moment. 
 You'll build and run the operating system behind that: the launch calendar, the plan of record for every deliverable, the path materials take through review, and execution on launch day. You'll treat the launch process itself as a product — one with users across the company, a quality bar, and a roadmap — and drive adoption through influence. 
 This is a hands-on, high-ownership role on a lean product marketing team. When launch volume peaks, you'll contribute directly as a product marketer across all products and surfaces. If you've run launches where many moving parts had to converge at the same time, and you'd rather design the system than run it by hand, we'd like to meet you. 
 Responsibilities 

 Own the model launch calendar and sequencing across a broad portfolio of releases, coordinating timing with partner teams across marketing, product, and communications 

 Own the plan of record for each launch — deliverables, owners, dependencies, and deadlines — and surface risks early enough to act on them 

 Own the path launch materials take through review, partnering with legal, policy, research, and communications so reviews happen in the right sequence against dates people can plan to 

 Drive decisions and alignment across senior cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority 

 Own launch-day execution: sequencing, timing, access, and the operational readiness of everything that goes live together 

 Own the internal resources our field teams reach for first, along with the operational side of enablement — scheduling, speakers, and materials logistics 

 Develop and improve launch processes, playbooks, and operational frameworks that scale beyond any one launch 

 Own launch retrospectives, recurring product communications, and — when volume requires it — launch materials themselves 

 You may be a good fit if you 

 Have owned launch or release operations end to end, and been accountable for launches landing on time and in good shape 

 Have built or substantially improved a launch or release process 

 Treat process as a product — you care whether people adopt what you build, and you measure it 

 Background in product marketing, product operations, technical program management, and launch production all fit 

 Work well when priorities and timelines shift, and can keep a complex plan coherent as details change 

 Are effective at driving decisions across senior stakeholders without direct authority 

 Have a technical background with the ability to understand and communicate complex AI concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences 

 Write clearly, and can produce launch-ready material 

 Are energized by ambiguity and moving fast in a rapidly evolving market 

 Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect staff to be able to work from our San Francisco or New York office at least 2 days a week. We encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time for relocation. 
 Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. 
   The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.  
 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $255,000 — $320,000 USD Logistics 
 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience 
 Required field of study:  A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience 
 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position 
 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. 
 Visa sponsorship:  We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. 
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit  anthropic.com/careers  directly for confirmed position openings. 
 How we're different 
 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. 
 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. 
 Come work with us! 
 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:  Learn about  our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.excerpt:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role 
 Alongside our model releases, Anthropic ships a steady stream of launches across the rest of the portfolio — products like Claude, Claude Code, and the developer platform; solutions for enterprises and startups; and the safeguards work that keeps Claude safe and trustworthy. Each launch brings product, engineering, policy, legal, communications, sales, and every part of marketing together around a single moment. 
 You'll be the central organizer of the product launch process for the product marketing team. You'll build and run the operating system behind it: the launch calendar, the plan of record for every deliverable, the path materials take through review, and execution on launch day. You'll treat the launch process itself as a product and drive adoption through influence. 
 In a portfolio this broad, not everything can get the same attention, so you'll focus your time on the team's top priorities, putting the most energy behind the launches that matter most and keeping the rest running on the systems you've built. 
 This is a hands-on, high-ownership role on a lean product marketing team. When launch volume peaks, you'll contribute directly as a product marketer across all products and surfaces. If you've run launches where many moving parts had to converge at the same time, and you'd rather design the system than run it by hand, we'd like to meet you. 
 Key responsibilities 

 Serve as one of the core organizers of the product launch process end to end: collaborating with peers across product, operations, and GTM 

 Own the product launch calendar and sequencing across a broad portfolio of releases — products, solutions, and programs — prioritizing your time against the team's top priorities and coordinating timing with partner teams across marketing, product, and communications 

 Own the plan of record for each launch, like deliverables, owners, dependencies, and deadlines, and surface risks early enough to act on them 

 Own the path launch materials take through review, partnering with legal, policy, product, and communications so reviews happen in the right sequence against dates people can plan to 

 Drive decisions and alignment across senior cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority 

 Own launch-day execution: sequencing, timing, access, and the operational readiness of everything that goes live together 

 Own the internal resources our field teams reach for first, along with the operational side of enablement, including scheduling, speakers, and materials logistics 

 Develop and improve launch processes, playbooks, and operational frameworks that scale beyond any one launch 

 Own launch retrospectives, recurring product communications, and — when volume requires it — launch materials themselves 

 You may be a good fit if you 

 Have owned launch or release operations end to end, and been accountable for launches landing on time and in good shape 

 Have built or substantially improved a launch or release process 

 Treat process as a product — you care whether people adopt what you build, and you measure it 

 Background in product marketing, product operations, technical program management, and launch production all fit 

 Work well when priorities and timelines shift, and can keep a complex plan coherent as details change 

 Are effective at driving decisions across senior stakeholders without direct authority 

 Have a technical background with the ability to understand and communicate complex AI concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences 

 Write clearly, and can produce launch-ready material 

 Are energized by ambiguity and moving fast in a rapidly evolving market 

 Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect staff to be able to work from our San Francisco or New York office at least 2 days a week. We encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time for relocation. 
 Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.  
 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $255,000 — $320,000 USD Logistics 
 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience 
 Required field of study:  A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience 
 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position 
 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. 
 Visa sponsorship:  We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. 
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit  anthropic.com/careers  directly for confirmed position openings. 
 How we're different 
 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. 
 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. 
 Come work with us!
